propositions: Rich-text encoding differs between Jira Cloud (ADF JSON) and Data Center (wiki/plain text), requiring separate code paths that are currently duplicated across backends

The RichTextCodec Protocol must define four separate operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) because Cloud has two distinct call paths that compose fit and normalize in different orders, and collapsing them would change observable behavior pinned by J1's oracles
AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py (not jira_family/) to satisfy J2's import-contract test forbidding jira_family/ from importing vendor-specific modules
A single implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in the shared jira_family/outbound_mapper.py taking RichTextCodec as a dependency, eliminating duplicate mapper code across backends
WikiTextCodec truncates at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT=32767 with marker ' … [truncated by reconciler]', matching adf.py's truncation suffix wording for consistency across deployments
